reviews.title: No longer supports Apple Watch or Apple Health
reviews.text:
Do not purchase the Zwift Bike if you intend to collect heart rate data, recovery, performance, or workout data with your Apple Watch while using Zwift App the company no longer supports the Apple Watch or Apple Health eco system  - will need to purchase separate heart rate monitor.  

Coincidentally Wahoo now sells their own HRM called Wahoo TRACKR Heart Rate Monitor.  Go figure!  

My Apple Watch  worked until recently (mid 2026) and I was forced to purchase a separate HRM so chose the Polar Verity Sense and Bluetooth it to Zwift and still use my Apple Watch and set it for indoor bike.  Not happy but best work around I could find!

reviews.title: Pretty unstable lately
reviews.text: Companion app loses workout stats in the middle of a workout. I guess it’s got disconnected from Zwift on TV. It reconnects, shows my RPM, power and map, but won’t show interval data and texts from the app. Zwift app itself crashes and loses rides, which is even worse. I was in the middle of an extensive workout, 30-40 minutes in and after the crash I have zero data. That’s really discouraging from using Zwift

reviews.title: Charging for Running now?
reviews.text: When logging on for run today, got stuck behind firewall making me pay for subscription. Not seeing any news or update that this is a new policy.

reviews.title: You can’t even sign in with saved passwords
reviews.text: It’s 2026, and you still can’t sign on with your saved password, you have to type everything out. This app is horrible and has horrible user experience. Clearly lacking product management and vision when you cannot even get the sign in flow correct.

reviews.title: Good, but a little chincy
reviews.text: The app/equipment experience gets 5 stars. But cmon, I bought a $1200 trainer setup and I’m restricted to 1 user. If I want to share the bike with a family member, I have to buy an additional subscription. The math for that doesn’t really justify the investment if you want two or three riders. I prob would have looked at other options if I’d known.

reviews.title: Charges after cancellation
reviews.text: Although the app works well, Zwift seems to be shady and will keep charging you after cancellation. I canceled them back in may and I just found out today they’ve been charging me the entire time without a subscription. Update 9/18/26 after digging into this more, Zwift knew I was being charged through the Apple Store and through their own website simultaneously. So I was being double charged every month and they were fully aware of this.  They also knew I canceled my membership but still charged me on the other payment hoping I wouldn’t notice. I would’ve never noticed if I didn’t recently go back to an iPhone because I was able to see the Apple Card charge notification. They essentially stole $100 from me and refused to refund me. Be wary after cancelling a membership that they’re still not charging you, because they’ll try their hardest not to pay it back

reviews.title: Horribly Buggy
reviews.text:
It’s fun when it works. Sometimes I’ll get a few months of it working but eventually the bugs come back and cause tons of problems. Drop ours mid ride, stolen drops from dropped connections, rides deleted from history, and more! 

I’ve used Zwift for approximately 10 years now and it’s always been a dumpster fire of problems. 

When I reach out to support they direct you to go talk to other users to solve your problem. This tells you all you need to know about this greedy company that doesn’t care about making a reliable product or service. 

Zwift should be ashamed of itself.

reviews.title: Gameified Fitness Miracle
reviews.text:
I fell down two stairs and broke my ankle badly. During the long healing and rehab, I got on an exercise bike at physical therapy, and liked it. I got an under desk bike when my PT ended, which I thought I’d use while working to keep my ankle loose. It game with a trial for Zwift. I was hooked. And my rehab accelerated. I upgraded to an exercise bike, completed the return to fitness workout plan, then the Grand Fondo plan, then I completed a 100KM ride, then I completed a 100 mile ride. On my 53rd birthday completed a 53 mile ride with 5300+ feet of climbing. I’ve grown to class C racing. I got the Tron bike. I did the spring classics on 100%. I’ve met a lot of folks around the world, and ridden 100ks regularly. I did the Rapha 500 and the Pas Normal 1000. 

All in an app because I fell down two stairs. Zwift didn’t save my life. But it made my life a lot better.

reviews.title: Riding is great, customer service is horrendous
reviews.text: Not sure who is directing Zwift coders, but adding features like a Scotty squirrel rather than fixing basic mechanics is insane. Every custom workout I run drops time in the app (ie 2hr ride completes in 1hr 58minutes and change). New routes on existing roads rather than new roads is a cheap move. Customer service never fixes glitches. I rode an event stage twice to completion, got the completion in ride before saving, and didn’t get credit either time. Ticket was never resolved, nor even responded too. Small one - you can apply jersey codes if you use iPad or appletv. Feels pretty discriminatory….shouldn’t this be a simple fix?

reviews.title: ZWIFT IS THE BEST APP EVER!!!!

Whether you’re training seriously or just riding for fun, this app has something for everyone. Highly recommend to any cyclist! 🚴‍♂️🔥

reviews.title: Custom WKO building IPad needs improvement
reviews.text: When building a custom workout on the IPad, which makes of 50% plus of what I use the app for there are MAJOR glitches. To name a few: Character limit in description box, When pasting directions from coach here they always get cut off. iPad Magic Keyboard no longer works, need to use app display keyboard on IPad screen (big pain in @ss). Over sensitive, pulled down zone blocks appear and disappear. Offsetting in workout text is complicated, I could go on but running out of space. Please just make it do what I click. In the world on Training peaks Virtual that has instant implication its becoming increasingly hard to not let the frustrations get the best of me.

reviews.title: The customer service is bad
reviews.text:
The app itself is good. Perfect for winter training rainy seasons etc.

I’ve been zwifting for years now. Way back when jarvis was the knly pace bot.

So 2 years ago i bought a zwift bike and the bike bike came with a bent chainring (really common issue with them) return it and the second one they gave me was beat up like a used one that was returned. 3rd bike they sent me was dropped by the fedex delivery. 

4th bike was flawless because i threatened them with a charge back all while dealing with the annoying Ai backed CS team. 2 years after using the bike the strap for the ipad holder snapped and i asked them if i could buy a replacement they said i have yo buy the entire ipad holder to get the rubber strap. Im not buying a 50 dollar ipad holder for me to get just the strap. This is the last ime im dealing with their CS team. If this bike becomes fully integrated with rouvy or swoosh i’m moving out of zwift not because i don’t like it but because the CS team made it hard for us to deal with them. Check some groups on facebook about the rant.

reviews.title: Fat to fit
reviews.text: It is an understatement how this app brought me back to health. I used to mountain bike in my teens and early 20s, until I broke my leg after slipping on a puddle on my way to work. This app brought my sanity back as well as brought me back to a healthy lifestyle after I got several pounds heavier. Great community, healthy competition, and overall amazing experience.

reviews.title: Connectivity is Terrible
reviews.text: Literally spend 15-45min some days just trying to reconnect. Nearly everyday takes some different method to have to figure out again, (Zwift only, companion app only, Zwift to cog / companion app for click). the Zwift click connectivity is the worst (good luck getting both to connect at the same time). every app update takes 45min to 1.5hrs to figure out a new process. Extremely frustrating experience!!!!!!

reviews.title: Has kept me sane 💚
reviews.text: As a runner who has been stuck inside for weeks on a barebones treadmill (a 2020 Sole TT8), Zwift has kept me sane. I wish there were more features for runners, but since it’s free for us, I can’t complain. I love the different courses and sometimes I run a little farther than planned just to see more of the world. I liked it so much that I bought the foot pod so I can Zwift with me on vacation for hotel treadmills. Thanks for letting runners enjoy this app, too. 💚

reviews.title: Feature request!
reviews.text: The only thing keeping my review from being 5 stars is both the lack of a family plan and the inability to keep more than 2 accounts saved on one device. My family of 4 shares one zwift trainer and an iPad, and it’s getting old having to log in each time rather than toggle between users. You already have this feature for 2 users. Why not 4 or more? I’m sure it’s not uncommon for cycling families to all use the same trainer. Other than this, we love it! Our collective fitness climbing to new heights, like my avatar in Alpe du Zwift!

reviews.title: Did not fix resistance for Wahoo KICKR Snap
reviews.text: I have been using Zwift and my Wahoo KICKR Snap for over a year. Then this ‘bug fix’ came out which screwed up my resistance. Now the trainer adds resistance at the most random spots on the course both in workout mode, free ride, or in an event.  I get dropped right away. I use the companion app while on the Apple TV and trainer (using Bluetooth).  All software and firmware is in the most current versions and I’ve done multiple spindle downs with no success. I’ve had to jump off my trainer mid-ride because the resistance would bring my pedaling to a hault it was so strong.  Sometimes, I couldn’t even get out of my lowest gear. It’s beyond frustrating and I’m about to toss out the trainer and delete my Zwift account. Please do another update.
